public.description: Open source, safe for public consumption and contribution.

internal.description: Internal system logic, operational tooling, and non-sensitive business logic.

restricted.description: Critical security infrastructure, secrets management, and sensitive financial/user data.

registry.reason: Service discovery interface must be accessible.

dashboard.reason: Displays internal system state and metrics.

i-match.reason: Handles business logic and matching algorithms.

autonomous-executor.reason: Executes tasks on behalf of the system.

credentials-manager.reason: Stores and manages sensitive secrets and keys.

landing-page.reason: Public entry point and marketing material.

membership.reason: Manages user accounts (sensitive PII handled carefully).

orchestrator.reason: Central nervous system for task coordination.
